mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM prc_price p WHERE p.type = 'MATERIAL' AND p.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND p.material_id = #{materialId} AND p.unit = #{unit} AND NOT p.voided AND p.effective_date <= #{date} AND (p.material_sku_id = #{skuId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR p.material_sku_id IS NULL) ORDER BY p.material_sku_id IS NULL, p.effective_date DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1

WITH k (supplier_id, style_id, process_mode) AS ( VALUES (#{x.supplierId}::bigint, #{x.styleId}::bigint, #{x.processMode}::varchar)
) SELECT p.* FROM k JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.* FROM prc_price p WHERE p.type = 'PROCESS' AND p.supplier_id = k.supplier_id AND p.style_id = k.style_id AND p.process_mode = k.process_mode AND NOT p.voided AND p.effective_date <= #{date} ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) p ON true

SELECT p.* FROM prc_price p WHERE true
AND NOT p.voided ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT p.material_id FROM prc_price p WHERE p.type = 'MATERIAL'
mapper.sql: q.type = cur.type AND q.supplier_id = cur.supplier_id AND q.material_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cur.material_id AND q.material_sku_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cur.material_sku_id AND q.style_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cur.style_id AND q.process_mode IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cur.process_mode AND q.unit = cur.unit AND NOT q.voided
mapper.select:
WITH u (material_id, unit) AS (
SELECT NULL::bigint, NULL::varchar WHERE false
VALUES (#{x.materialId}::bigint, #{x.unit}::varchar)
), cur AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.type, p.supplier_id, p.material_id, p.material_sku_id, p.style_id, p.process_mode) p.* FROM prc_price p LEFT JOIN u ON u.material_id = p.material_id WHERE NOT p.voided AND (p.type = 'PROCESS' OR p.unit = u.unit)
ORDER BY p.type, p.supplier_id, p.material_id, p.material_sku_id, p.style_id, p.process_mode, p.effective_date > #{today}, CASE WHEN p.effective_date <= #{today} THEN p.effective_date END DESC, p.effective_date, p.id DESC ) SELECT cur.*, prev.price AS prev_price, nxt.price AS next_price, nxt.effective_date AS next_date FROM cur LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT q.price FROM prc_price q WHERE AND cur.effective_date <= #{today} AND (q.effective_date, q.id) < (cur.effective_date, cur.id) ORDER BY q.effective_date DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) prev ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT q.price, q.effective_date FROM prc_price q WHERE AND cur.effective_date <= #{today} AND q.effective_date > #{today} ORDER BY q.effective_date, q.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) nxt ON true ORDER BY cur.type, cur.supplier_id, cur.material_id, cur.material_sku_id NULLS FIRST, cur.style_id, cur.process_mode, cur.id
